All Products / Training Shorts / Cyber-Gradient Shorts

PRIVATE LABEL · OEM / ODM

Cyber-Gradient Pro Training & Fight Shorts

Geometric color. A clean athletic silhouette.

Develop custom training and fight shorts around a striking blue-purple waistband, adjustable drawcord and curved leg opening. A distinctive starting point for gym brands, MMA training collections and custom teamwear.

  • 92% polyester / 8% spandex shell brief
  • Blue-purple geometric waistband
  • Curved side openings and printed mesh trim
  • Custom colors, logos, labels and fit
Request custom pricing →

DESIGNED AROUND MOVEMENT

Four details that define this training short.

Cyber-gradient identity

Cyan-to-purple geometric artwork on the waistband, paired with bright blue drawcords and vertical gradient branding.

Adjustable elastic waist

A gathered elastic waistband and external drawcord provide an adjustable fit. Confirm tension, cord security and recovery on the sample.

Curved side openings

The scalloped hem creates space around the leg opening for training movement. Slit height and edge finish can be developed to your brief.

Printed mesh inner trim

The supplied close-ups show a purple geometric mesh detail inside the hem. Review its placement and skin contact during sampling.

EIGHT PRODUCT VIEWS

Inspect the details before you develop your version.

IN MOTION

A closer look at the gradient details.

Supplied promotional overview · approximately 15 seconds. Product visualization does not establish a measured performance test.

CRAFTSMANSHIP & DEVELOPMENT

From geometric artwork to an approved garment.

Printed panel development

Develop the waistband and mesh artwork through approved print swatches. Sublimation suitability, color accuracy and wash durability depend on the selected material and process.

Seam & stress-point planning

Review the visible sewn hems and panel seams. Confirm needle/thread construction, bar-tack positions and seam strength before production; no unbreakable-seam claim is made.

Curved hem finishing

Inspect the edge stitching and the inside finish for flatness, loose threads and contact with the thigh. The photographs show a sewn finish, not proof of heat-bonded construction.

Branding process approval

Specify the vertical wordmark, leg emblem and rear emblem for your own artwork. Confirm whether transfer, TPU or another process suits the fabric; approve stretch and wash checks.

Specifications & sample approval

Supplied brief and construction checks for custom training shorts
Outer fabric brief92% polyester / 8% spandex stretch woven — supplied specification; verify the selected fabric record. Exact GSM is not supplied.
Inner detailPrinted stretch polyester mesh lining/trim. Fiber ratio, weight and total coverage need confirmation; do not assume a full fitted inner short.
ColorwayBlack shell with cyan, purple and magenta geometric print; bright blue drawcord.
Waist constructionElastic waistband with visible external drawcord. Internal routing and reinforcement details require sample confirmation.
Cut & measurementsAbove-knee athletic cut with curved side openings. The proposed 5–7 inch inseam is a development range, not a measured sample dimension.
StitchingSewn panel and hem reference. Final seam type, thread, reinforcement and tolerances are recorded on the approved specification.
Custom optionsColors, geometric artwork, logos, waist details, fit, labels and packaging; review each option before quotation.
Care directionWash cold inside out with like colors; hang dry preferred. Approve the final care label for the selected fabric and decoration.

PROJECT FIT & ORDER CONDITIONS

Is this the right starting point for your order?

For brands and teams developing geometric-print athletic training shorts with an adjustable waist and a curved hem. Review contact-sport suitability, drawcords and any hardware on the selected version.

Order planning and procurement conditions
Starting quantitySelected projects from 10 pieces; minimum per style, design and colorway is confirmed in writing.
Mixed sizesProvide size allocations by colorway and approve one measurement chart with numerical tolerances.
Sample timingThe 3–7 day target begins after artwork and details are confirmed. New sourcing, patterns or revisions may extend it.
Quote scopeConfirm fabric, branding, labels, packaging, sampling charges and shipping basis in one project quote.
Repeat ordersRetain the approved sample, artwork, fabric record, size chart and packing specification; recheck availability when reordering.

Custom training & fight shorts: buyer questions

What are these custom training and fight shorts designed for?

They are an OEM/ODM reference for gym training, striking workouts and fightwear collections. Confirm fit and movement on a sample; for BJJ/MMA grappling or competition, review drawcord security, pockets, hardware and event rules separately.

What is the shell composition?

The supplied brief specifies 92% polyester / 8% spandex stretch woven. Exact GSM and measurable stretch, drying, tear and water-resistance properties are not supplied and require a selected material record or test.

Is this a full two-in-one compression liner?

The images show printed mesh at the inside hem. They do not establish a full fitted compression liner. Confirm the inner panel coverage, lining construction and any required two-in-one version during sampling.

Can I customize the blue-purple geometric print and logos?

Yes. Discuss your own colors, geometric artwork, vertical wordmark, emblem, labels and packaging. Confirm print/transfer method, artwork permissions, color matching and wash performance on the approved sample.

What sizes and quantities should I send?

Send waist, hip, rise, outseam, inseam, leg opening and slit-height requirements, followed by quantities per size and colorway. Confirm actual measurements and tolerances rather than relying on a generic 5–7 inch range.

Are the shorts guaranteed tear-proof, non-chafing or permanently colorfast?

No measured test is supplied for those absolute claims. Review seam strength, abrasion, colorfastness, elastic recovery and skin-contact comfort on the selected fabric and physical sample.

What are the minimum order and sample conditions?

Selected custom projects start at 10 pieces. Confirm minimums per style, design and colorway. The advertised 3–7 day sample target begins after artwork and details are confirmed; sourcing, patterns and revisions can change timing.
